scope: Revalidate captured DXF MLINE LTYPE providers at write finalization so late source mutation refuses publication atomically and permits a corrected retry.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: The DXF finalizer rechecked MLINE styles and consumers but did not recheck captured MLINE LTYPE providers after serialization callbacks. A live provider mutation after its TABLES inspection could therefore reach the staged-output completion boundary without a final provider-integrity check.
implementationReadiness.change: dx_iface::finalizeDxfWrite now requires hasUnchangedDxfMLineLinetypes() before accepting the completed DXF operation. The referenced-flag control was aligned with the current LTYPE group-70 domain: valid flag profiles 16 and 48 exercise refusal on unsafe MLINE retargeting, while the valid entity-referenced flag-64 edit remains covered by the positive edit profiles above it. Unsupported standalone flag values are covered by the dedicated LTYPE domain controls.

coverage: The referenced-flag selector exercises 24 late provider mutations across ASCII/Binary output and four callback phases; each failed operation preserves the sentinel destination and leaves the callback mutation observable in caller data, then restoring the provider allows a same-adapter retry with caller-state and readback checks.
The provider-profile selector covers provider changes before output and at serializer callback boundaries, atomic refusal, caller-state checks, and corrected retry.

The referenced-flag selector retains positive edit/readback coverage for flag 64 and refusal/readback coverage for valid profiles 16 and 48; invalid flag domains remain covered by dedicated LTYPE tests.

limitations: Generated adapter transaction controls only; no physical drawing producer or native CAD acceptance was established.
The finalizer check is scoped to preserving the captured MLINE LTYPE provider state and does not establish broader MLINE rendering or support parity.
No DWG/DXF fixture files were added, and no support claim is promoted.
nextReadyPacket: Continue with the next independently actionable source-backed P4-P6 item; preserve external/native qualification gates and select a focused owning selector before implementation.
